releaseNotes: New Order Management — edit existing orders before completion or delivery, including measurements, garments, items and order cancellation.
Quick Bill improvements — place orders without measurements and add measurements later when the customer is available.
Fabric inventory improvements — fabrics can now be selected even when stock is zero or insufficient, with shortages monitored without blocking the order.
Flexible fabric pricing — change the selling price of fabric during order placement or order editing, with an option to update the saved inventory price.
Improved garment combinations — added Safari, Two Piece and Jodhpuri Suit as integrated combo garments with their required measurements.
Multiple Offer Sale — create multiple offer-sale entries with different prices and quantities, customize offer names, and clearly display shirt and pant quantities.
Improved billing — clearer discount, advance payment, payment method and transfer summaries with improved bill readability.
Combined bill improvements — choose the required GVT or SC bill format and display fabric units clearly when using the GVT format.
Improved measurement slips — better measurement arrangement, clearer spacing and improved urgent-order visibility.
Improved customer and order workflow — better measurement handling, order history and activity tracking for greater transparency.
Improved bill typography — slightly larger, clearer text while preserving proper alignment and preventing overflow.
Improved startup experience — the application now starts maximized and can launch automatically with Windows.
Improved customer data entry — customer and organization names are automatically formatted with proper capitalization.
Improved order and inventory integration — better coordination between inventory, suppliers, orders and billing.
Bug fixes, stability improvements and UI refinements.
